mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders( order_no, member_no, orderer_name, orderer_phone_number, orderer_email, order_status, total_price, created_at, receiver_name, receiver_phone_number, receiver_zip_code, receiver_base_address, receiver_detail_address, message ) VALUES ( orders_seq.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{ordererName}, #{ordererPhoneNumber}, #{ordererEmail}, 'ORDERED', #{totalPrice}, SYSDATE, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhoneNumber}, #{receiverZipCode}, #{receiverBaseAddress}, #{receiverDetailAddress}, #{message} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone_number = #{receiverPhoneNumber}, receiver_zip_code = #{receiverZipCode}, receiver_base_address = #{receiverBaseAddress}, receiver_detail_address = #{receiverDetailAddress}, message = #{message} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
